text: LANDED at merge d8fe4a9. Chief gate on the merged tree, unpiped, SBT_EXIT=0, zero errors: scalafmt both, compileAll all platforms, FULL testJVM - run broad deliberately because adding a case to MissingReason can break exhaustive matches repo-wide; it broke none. ALL SIX CHIEF CONDITIONS VERIFIED IN THE MERGED TREE BEFORE GATING: (1) three distinct reasons as package constants - Unclassified, ClassifiedUninterpretable, SourceUnitAbsent - not collapsed; (2) MissingReason.Custom(namespace,label) added to MissingReason itself, mirroring UndefinedReason.Custom and MalformedReason.Custom; (3) specificity built with details.map, not flatMap, so every detail has an entry and omission cannot masquerade as absence; (4) Ineligible NOT added to Estimate - zero occurrences, the deferred 31-site change stayed deferred; (5) no Custom label duplicates a generic reason; (6) the remaining discourse classes unchanged, with an in-code comment naming bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV as the owner of their eligibility migration. KNOWN REMAINING, correctly deferred rather than hidden: Metacognitive/Evaluative/Repair/TaskCommentary still receive observed(0.0); they are Ineligible in truth and Estimate cannot say so yet.
